source.edition: ALUPROF Price list for ready-made products, valid from 15 September 2026 (footer code 20260914); 120 pages; printed page number = PDF page + 2

priceBasis: List prices in EUR, VAT not included ('PRICES GIVEN IN €, VAT NOT INCLUDED'), before dealer discount (percentage surcharges are applied to the system price after discount). Motor included for SB400 (pp.12-15), Pergola V ZIIIP and Veranda V ZIIIP; motor NOT included for R ZIIIP 120, VERANDA, MADEIRA and CORSICA (surcharge); AUSTRALIA/JAMAICA priced with manual crank. All dimensions converted to cm; 'page' = PDF page index.

products.description: Bioclimatic aluminium pergola with motorised rotating blades (SB 400). Free-standing, wall-mounted, SB 400 R and a roof-module (blades on guides) version.

variants.label: Pergola SB 400 free-standing (no middle pole)
variants.config: PERGOLA SB 400 FREE-STANDING – no middle pole
variants.priceIncludes: structure, louvers (blades), drive transmission mechanism and motor (visible-motor version). Control (receiver/remote) NOT included - see options. Intermediate posts NOT included.
variants.notes: Printed table header: 'Width [mm] / no middle pole'. This is the ONLY column group printed on the page (no other column groups such as 'with middle pole' exist in this edition), so one variant per page. Width = blade/beam direction (150-400 cm), projection 340-700 cm in 20 cm steps (projection can be ordered at 20 cm intervals). Minimum dimensions printed: visible motor PICOLO XL 230V width 140 x projection 160 cm; 24V motor width 140 x projection 140 cm; hidden motor Somfy TILT 24V width 140 x projection 240 cm (the table itself starts at projection 340 cm - pricing of projections below 340 cm is not printed). Hidden-motor version: +10% of system price after discount. Gaskets black only. Free-standing → freestanding.

variants.label: Pergola SB 400 wall-mounted (no middle pole)
variants.config: PERGOLA SB400 WALL-MOUNTED – No middle pole
variants.priceIncludes: structure, louvers (blades),  wall mounting (appropriate for the selected version), drive transmission mechanism and motor (visible-motor version). Control (receiver/remote) NOT included - see options. Intermediate posts NOT included.
variants.notes: Printed table header: 'Width [mm] / no middle pole'. This is the ONLY column group printed on the page (no other column groups such as 'with middle pole' exist in this edition), so one variant per page. Width = blade/beam direction (150-400 cm), projection 340-700 cm in 20 cm steps (projection can be ordered at 20 cm intervals). Minimum dimensions printed: visible motor PICOLO XL 230V width 140 x projection 160 cm; 24V motor width 140 x projection 140 cm; hidden motor Somfy TILT 24V width 140 x projection 240 cm (the table itself starts at projection 340 cm - pricing of projections below 340 cm is not printed). Hidden-motor version: +10% of system price after discount. Gaskets black only. Wall-mounted → wall.

variants.label: Pergola SB 400 R
variants.priceIncludes: structure, slats, wall mounts (appropriate for the selected version), drive transmission mechanism and motor; two gutters without water drainage. Control NOT included.
variants.notes: Same dimension grid as SB 400 (width 150-400, projection 340-700 cm, 20 cm steps); no column-group label printed. Page 27: 'SB400R – water drainage on the client's side. Dedicated DN50 gutter outlets.' No posts are priced or mentioned on this page and the price includes wall mounts, so mapped to no_legs (fixed to walls / existing structure) - see uncertainties. Hidden motor +10%. Option: 4 gutters with angle overflows 250 EUR (not discountable).

variants.label: Pergola SB 400 – roof module (SB400MD, blades on guides, Picolo XL motor)
variants.priceIncludes: guides, slat system, drive transmission mechanism, motor (Picolo XL only). Receiver and remote NOT included. Sealing slats NOT included.
variants.notes: Projection breakpoints printed as 1430, 1830 ... 7030 mm (143-703 cm, 200 mm increments); width 100-400 cm. Minimum dimensions: width 100 cm, projection 123 cm. Motor is not attached to the guides and partially protrudes; page 27 says 'load-bearing substructure required' for SB400MD → mapped to existing_structure.

limits.notes: Per single module as printed: width (blade length) 150-400 cm, projection 340-700 cm (roof module 100-400 x 143-703). Standard clear height up to 2800 mm (intermediate post prices exist for 200-280 cm); heights 2801-3300 mm are an 'above standard' option with partial warranty exclusions (+250 EUR free-standing / +150 EUR wall-mounted). NOTE: the PDF's width axis max is 400 cm and projection max 700 cm, i.e. the opposite orientation to the customer's spec (700 wide x 400 projection). No multi-module / coupled price tables exist on pp. 12-15.

uncertainties: Task asked to separate 'No middle pole' vs other column groups: pages 12 and 13 print only ONE column group ('no middle pole' / 'No middle pole'); page 14 (SB 400 R) has no group label. No other groups exist in this edition.

Axis orientation: the PDF puts width (blade/beam length) at max 400 cm and projection at max 700 cm. The customer spec (700 wide x 400 projection) is the opposite orientation - confirm which side the customer calls 'width'.

Customer spec mentions 2 modules for 701-1400 width / 401-800 projection: the PDF has NO multi-module or coupled tables for SB 400 (pp. 12-15); how coupled systems are priced (e.g. sum of modules) is not stated.
Minimum dimensions printed (projection 140/160/240 cm) are below the first table row (340 cm); price for projections < 340 cm is not printed (presumably the 340 row applies) (p.12-14).
SB 400 R mountType: page does not explicitly state free-standing/wall; price includes wall mounts and no posts are mentioned -> mapped to no_legs. Confirm with Aluprof (p.14, p.27).
Roof module gutters table header says 'Projection [cm]' but the values 1430...7030 are clearly mm (same as the main table) (p.15).
LED points 3300 K: the sub-columns '1500 - 2740' and '2750 - 4000' have no axis label; assumed width in mm (p.20).
Single-colour LED control with Teleco controller (hidden motor) has no printed price; p.12 says 'Standard MiLight controller with remote control included in the price' (p.12-14).

Page 6 RAL rule: 15% for RAL outside the ALUPROF palette; all 35 ALUPROF palette colours are 'option available' (no surcharge) for Pergolas on p.7; wood effects are 'option with surcharge' (20% for SB400 per p.6).

uncertainties: AUSTRALIA and JAMAICA have only a manual-drive table (p.96); there is no printed electric-drive price table. Electric = manual price + motor set (pp.100-105); whether the crank/gear included in the manual price is deducted is not stated. Captured manual as the only variant.

MADEIRA and CORSICA are motor-only and their tables EXCLUDE the motor (p.96). The motor must be chosen from pp.100-105 according to p.107 compatibility (Madeira: only Somfy NEMO-H IO YELLOW, codes SB 456 € / QU 730 €).
MADEIRA table on p.96 has no printed axis headings or colour list; rows 160-360 / width ranges 205-290 ... 591-600 assumed same meaning as other tables.
Width columns are ranges; 'cols' are range upper bounds (290, 350, ... 700/600). Lowest range lower bound is 195 (Australia) / 205 (others) cm.
Motor torque per size (p.106): torque A (30 Nm) for 2-arm sizes up to 531-590 cm width at projections 160-310; torque B (40-50 Nm) for 3-arm cells and all 360 cm projection cells.
LED lighting in arms (p.108): columns '3100'/'3600' are presumably arm length in mm (i.e. projection 310/360 cm); prices for shorter arms are not printed.
Page 99 brackets (wall/ceiling/rafter/niche) are listed without per-model applicability.
Somfy remote controls for RTS/io on printed pp.113-118 (PDF 111-116) are not extracted; the awning drive pages contain their own remote/sensor prices (captured).
